newsitem.title: UK: EDP fuel buy tender decision due Wednesday - trade.
newsitem.headline: EDP fuel buy tender decision due Wednesday - trade.

text.p: Portugal's state electricity company Electricidade de Portugal (EdP) should announce the results of its tender to buy high sulphur fuel on Wednesday, trade sources said on Tuesday.
The tender was for two 25,000 tonne cargoes of 3.5 percent cracked fuel for delivery June 2-6 and June 8-12, with an option for EdP to take a third 25,000 tonne load on June 25-27, the source said.
Bidding closed on Tuesday as did offers for Egypt's low sulphur straight run sell tender out of Alexandria.
Two 25,000 tonne cargoes of straight-run were on offer -- one for on June 14-16, the other on June 25-27. It was not immediately clear when the results would be announced.
